thought: Same VCP leader upper-half breakout signals. Change only the buy: 缩量回踩 instead of T+1 breakout fill. Intact-pivot-pullback already stopped; this is not that 5-day pivot-hold + reclaim-high rule.
hypothesis: Buying the first shrink-volume pullback within 8 market sessions after the signal, without undercutting the signal low, has higher independent avg_pnl than buying the breakout next open on the same 321-name book.

change.definition: Do not take the original T+1 fill. After entry_signal_date, on the next 8 market sessions, take the first bar with volume < mean volume of the prior 20 market sessions, close < signal close, and low >= signal low. Buy the next market open if that session is strictly before the original exit. PnL is new entry open to original exit price, same costs. A hole, missing 20-session volume history, or blocked buy does not roll; that signal is absent from the variant book.

metric.primary: independent win_rate, profit_factor, avg_pnl of pullback fills vs the 321 breakout fills
metric.validation_if_keep: same rule on 2023-2026 completed upper-half signals

pass_fail.pass: variant avg_pnl not below the 321-trade breakout baseline and remains positive
pass_fail.fail: Drop this buy. Baseline stays 321 T+1 breakout. Next still VCP (企稳买) or pause VCP and open 放量突破·缩量回踩 as its own book.
